summary: Appending an empty rope previously inserted an empty leaf beneath an internal root, violating the invariant that non-root leaves contain text. The fix skips appending an empty operand and replaces an empty receiver directly with the other rope. The upstream test rope::tests::append_05, added by this commit, appends an empty rope and checks tree invariants. Reversing only Rope::append restores the faulty handling. This plan has not been executed.
